title: Custom REST endpoint in the Custom API SDK
summary: Add a controller and service to Custom.Api.Core that calls the Znode APIs through the typed Znode clients and returns a custom response shape.
when_to_use: a storefront or integration needs a response shape the Znode APIs do not return
combine several Znode API calls into one endpoint
add business logic around Znode data
not_for: changing how Znode itself calculates prices, taxes or promotions
changing the response of an existing Znode API

contract.pattern: ControllerBase + [ApiController] + [Route("[controller]")]; service interface registered in CustomDependencyRegistration.RegisterCustomDI; Znode clients (for example IOrderClient, ICustomTableClient, ICommerceCollectionsClient) registered there too
contract.deployment_per_kb: Znode deploy CustomAPISDK <Environment> [<SDK path>]; endpoint https://<CustomAPISDKHostedURL>/<Controller>/<Action>; host in the same VNET as the Znode API

evidence.note: where services and Znode clients are registered
controller that calls the Commerce client through ICustomService

apis.note: call the Znode API family that owns the data; see api-catalog

limitations: Runs as a separate microservice: it adds a network hop to every call
Authentication, authorization and ownership checks are the developer's responsibility (see quality-security-checks)
The SDK has no unit-test project: create one
KB: changes to Znode's own APIs are not possible from the SDK (they go through a Znode support ticket): that is the Platform Change route
known_issues: CustomBaseClient.cs creates a new HttpClient per call and blocks on .Result (see sdk-conventions); do not copy this pattern

unverified: JWT configuration values for a specific environment
